properties.headline: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued September 18 at 6:42PM MDT until September 18 at 7:15PM MDT by NWS Grand Junction CO
properties.description:
SVRGJT

The National Weather Service in Grand Junction has issued a

* Severe Thunderstorm Warning for...
Southeastern Moffat County in northwestern Colorado...

* Until 715 PM MDT.

* At 642 PM MDT, a severe thunderstorm was located 30 miles northwest
of Meeker, or 30 miles west of Craig, moving east at 30 mph.

HAZARD...Ping pong ball size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...People and animals outdoors will be injured. Expect
damage to roofs, siding, windows, and vehicles.

* Locations impacted include...
Lay, Maybell, and Juniper Springs.

properties.headline: Flood Advisory issued September 18 at 6:33PM MDT until September 18 at 9:30PM MDT by NWS Goodland KS
properties.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall is expected.

* WHERE...Northeastern Kit Carson County in east central Colorado...

* WHEN...Until 930 PM MDT.

* IMPACTS...Minor flooding in low-lying and poor drainage areas.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 633 PM MDT, Doppler radar indicated heavy rain due to
thunderstorms. Minor flooding is ongoing or expected to begin
shortly in the advisory area. Up to 2 inches of rain have fallen.
- Dispatch reports U.S. 385 flooding north of Burlington, CO
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Mainly rural areas of Northeastern Kit Carson County.

properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued September 18 at 4:52PM MDT until September 18 at 7:45PM MDT by NWS Grand Junction CO
properties.description:
FFWGJT

The National Weather Service in Grand Junction has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
Southwestern Moffat County in northwestern Colorado...
Western Rio Blanco County in northwestern Colorado...
East Central Uintah County in northeastern Utah...

* Until 745 PM MDT.

* At 452 PM MDT, Doppler radar indicated thunderstorms producing
heavy rain across the warned area. Flash flooding is ongoing or
expected to begin shortly.

HAZARD...Flash flooding. Thunderstorms producing flash flooding.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Flash flooding of creeks and streams, urban areas,
highways, and streets.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Dinosaur, Artesia and Blue Mountain.
properties.areaDesc: Moffat, CO; Rio Blanco, CO; Uintah, UT

properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued September 18 at 4:13PM MDT until September 18 at 7:15PM MDT by NWS Grand Junction CO
properties.description:
FFWGJT

The National Weather Service in Grand Junction has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
Northwestern Mesa County in west central Colorado...

* Until 715 PM MDT.

* At 413 PM MDT, Doppler radar indicated thunderstorms producing
heavy rain across the warned area. Between 0.4 and 0.8 inches of
rain have fallen. The expected rainfall rate is 1.5 to 3 inches in
1 hour. Flash flooding is ongoing or expected to begin shortly.

HAZARD...Life threatening flash flooding. Thunderstorms producing
flash flooding.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Life threatening flash flooding of creeks and streams,
urban areas, highways, streets and underpasses.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Loma and Mack. This includes portions of I-70 between mile markers
8 and 15.
